@graph.description: BPC-157 is a synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide studied mainly in animal models for tissue repair and inflammation. FDA identified five small human clinical studies in its 2026 review, but the evidence is short-duration, heterogeneous, and insufficient to establish clinical efficacy or long-term safety; BPC-157 is not FDA-approved.
